headline: MGM Q2 Deep Dive: Las Vegas, Macau, and Digital Expansion Shape Outlook
summary: Hospitality and casino entertainment company MGM Resorts (NYSE:MGM) reported Q2 CY2026 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 1% year on year to $4.45 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.59 per share was 1.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
